## 1. Executive Summary & Studio Thesis

Aeethod is not a generic web design agency or a monthly subscription SaaS vendor. Aeethod is a specialized vertical systems studio that designs, engineers, and permanently deploys sovereign digital infrastructure for high-growth Trading Card Game (TCG) retailers, local game stores (LGS), and collectibles enterprises.

### The Problem Card Shops Face:
High-volume card shops manage between 50,000 and 250,000 unique SKUs across Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, and Lorcana. Generic retail platforms fail card shops in three catastrophic ways:
1. **Marketplace Rent Trap:** Marketplaces like TCGplayer and eBay charge 12% to 15%+ in transaction and commission fees, which consumes 40% to 60% of gross margin on high-velocity singles.
2. **Rented SaaS Fragility:** Specialized TCG SaaS tools (BinderPOS, CrystalCommerce) cost $300 to $800+/month in recurring rent, suffer frequent checkout crashes during big set release weekends, and retain full code custody—if a merchant leaves, their website vanishes.
3. **Shopify 100-Variant Ceiling:** Shopify hard-caps variants at 100 per product record. A single card with 5 conditions, 3 finishes, 4 languages, and graded slabs exceeds 150+ variants, forcing shops to fragment single cards into multiple URLs, ruining organic search rankings (SEO) and frustrating collectors.

### The Aeethod Solution:
Aeethod builds sovereign, owned custom platforms built on Next.js, React, and serverless edge databases. Merchants own 100% of their codebase, customer database, and transaction flow with $0/month software rent and 0% sales commission cuts.

She architects the real-time data pipelines and webhook meshes that keep hundreds of thousands of card SKUs synchronized across counter POS, TCGplayer, and web storefronts without double-selling.

| Capability | Legacy SaaS (BinderPOS / CrystalCommerce) | Generic Shopify | Aeethod Custom Architecture |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Code Ownership** | Rented ($299–$800/mo) | Rented SaaS Theme | **100% Client Owned (Permanent)** |
| **Sales Commission Cut** | Variable / Add-on fees | Shopify Payments | **0% Sales Commission Cut** |
| **Card Search Latency** | 1,800ms – 4,000ms | 2,000ms – 3,500ms | **Sub-35ms (Instant Edge Filter)** |
| **Single Card Variants** | Fragmented listings | Max 100 variants | **300+ Variants on 1 Clean URL** |
| **Inventory Sync Speed** | 15 – 45 minutes | 15 – 30 minutes | **Sub-1.8 Seconds (Real-time Mesh)** |
| **Automated Buylist Portal** | Clunky add-on | Requires 3rd-party apps | **Integrated Turnkey Portal** |

## 4. Turnkey Service Tiers

1. **Shopify TCG Kickstart ($3,500 – $4,800):**
   - Ideal for stores operating on Shopify seeking custom variant layers, sub-50ms search, and clean catalog presentation without splitting listings. Turnaround: 2–3 weeks.
2. **Custom TCG Commerce Platform ($7,800 – $9,800):**
   - Flagship turnkey deployment. Full headless Next.js architecture, 100% code ownership, sub-35ms card search, and 0% sales commission checkout. Turnaround: 4–6 weeks.
3. **Advanced Omnichannel TCG System ($14,500 – $18,500):**
   - Complete multi-location enterprise delivery. Includes real-time sub-2s sync between counter POS, TCGplayer, and eBay, plus an automated customer buylist portal and algorithmic repricing engine. Turnaround: 6–8 weeks.
